source.primary_law: Lei no 12.651, de 25 de maio de 2012 (Codigo Florestal) - texto compilado
source.note: Machine-readable distillation. Legal text of record is the .txt/.html in this folder. State-level (SEMA-MT) rules and municipal fiscal-module sizes override/refine these defaults.

app_full._meaning: Full-width APP required where there is NO consolidated rural occupation as of 2008-07-22.
app_full.measured_from: borda da calha do leito regular

artificial_reservoir.rule: width set by the environmental licence; none required if not from damming a natural watercourse

plateau_edge_m.scope: bordas de tabuleiros ou chapadas, ate a linha de ruptura do relevo

vereda_buffer_m.measured_from: limite do espaco permanentemente brejoso e encharcado

app_consolidated._meaning: Reduced recomposition ('escadinha') for areas under agrosilvopastoral use consolidated before 2008-07-22. Continuity of the activity is authorised; only the strip below must be replanted.

reserva_legal._meaning: Minimum share of the RURAL PROPERTY (imovel) that must carry native vegetation, on top of APP.

amazonia_legal.note: Where a property spans more than one of these, each index applies to its own portion (Art.12 par.2).

conditions: APP is conserved or under recomposition
owner has requested inclusion in CAR

recomposition_options.recomposition_schedule: at least 1/10 of the total area every 2 years (Art.66 par.2)
recomposition_options.compensation_must_be: same biome, and if outside the state, in areas identified as priority by the Uniao or the state (Art.66 par.6)

small_property_le_4mf.rule: For properties up to 4 fiscal modules, the Reserva Legal is the native vegetation existing on 2008-07-22; no recomposition of RL is required beyond that.

mato_grosso._pantanal_note: MT Pantanal is inside Amazonia Legal; treated as non-forest formation -> 0.35 unless classified as campos gerais (0.20). Flagged for legal review per municipality.
mato_grosso._mf_note: Fiscal module in MT ranges 30-100 ha by municipality (INCRA). Override per site from the INCRA table before any real filing.

mapbiomas_class_roles.note: Class 9 (silvicultura) is planted forest, NOT native vegetation, and does not satisfy RL.
